summary: Full backend + frontend regression for iteration 25 (Flowbuilder rewrite, AI Agents/Providers, Tags CRUD, Kanban with native column, onboarding base_type). All 15 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Frontend smoke test confirmed Tags, Kanban, Agente IA, Flowbuilder pages render correctly with no JS errors. Login + sidebar navigation OK as crm@test.com.

minor.issue: Default 'default-emergent' stub is returned only when user has zero providers — once a custom provider is added, default disappears. UI must handle that (consume providers list and fallback to 'emergent' visually if needed).
Returns generic 500 on LLM errors — consider 502 with structured error so UI can distinguish 'misconfigured' vs 'LLM downtime'. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured in backend/.env so happy-path works.

issues: scrollHeight=1099 vs clientHeight=1080 — 19px extra body scroll. Acceptable but not pixel-perfect; main agent's overflow-hidden wrapper handles it. Consider verifying on smaller viewports.

action_items: (Optional) Improve error response in /api/ai/agents/{id}/test for clearer UI handling.
(Optional) Verify Atendimentos layout on mobile viewport (390x844) and tablet — tested only on desktop 1920x1080.
Code-review found no blockers; main agent can ship.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_routes.py: /agents/{id}/test reuses Emergent universal key correctly; for non-emergent providers code falls back to provider_type='openai' instead of using the user's stored api_key — meaning custom OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini providers still call via Emergent key. Acceptable for now (Emergent supports those models) but documented behavior should match.
crm_routes.py: NATIVE_FIRST_COLUMN is a module-level dict reused across requests — safe because handlers don't mutate it, but if order-customization is added later, return a copy.
crm_routes.py /kanban-v2 returns up to 2000 tickets unsorted into columns in memory; fine for current scale, may need pagination per column when companies grow.

ai_routes.py list_providers excludes api_key in projection — good, but create_provider response also strips api_key which means UI cannot show a 'masked' indicator that key was saved. Consider returning has_api_key boolean.
Frontend imports use new file paths (TagsPage, KanbanPage, AIPage, FlowBuilderPage); old definitions correctly prefixed with _ to avoid name conflict — confirmed in Dashboard.js lines 837/1415.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (4/4 pages render, no JS errors)

seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up by test fixtures.
